theorem thm (A B C D : Point) (ABC DBC : Triangle) (h1 : Triangle.congruent ABC DBC) (h2 : A ≠ D) : ∃ (H : Point), ∃ (k : Line), ¬(k.intersectsLine (Line.endpoints A D)) ∧ h2 := by
  -- Use the given distinctness of points to find a new point H
  use A
  -- Use the line AD as the parallel line
  use Line.endpoints A D
  -- Simplify the proof by using the distinctness of points and the congruence of triangles
  simp [h1, h2]
  -- Use tauto to conclude the proof
